title: anemone pulsatilla subsp. halleri
intro: Anemone pulsatilla subsp. halleri, commonly known as Pasque flower, is a perennial plant species belonging to the buttercup family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, fever, and digestive problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Pasque flower include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Pasque flower include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
